description: This file defines the Success controller class for handling the order success page in the OpenCart catalog checkout process. It manages session data cleanup after a successful order, sets page titles and breadcrumbs, and loads various page components before rendering the success view.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: Controller class handling the checkout success page, performing cleanup of session data, setting page metadata, and rendering the success template.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked to display the success page, performing session cleanup, setting up breadcrumbs, and preparing the data for the view.
